From amp overdrive to screaming metal, you CAN have it all! $ 239.97 In stock Pinnacle Deluxe v2 quantity Add to cart SKU: WMP-PDO-PED Category: Distortion / Overdrive Tag: distortion warning Cancer and Reproductive Harm www.p65warnings.ca.gov task_alt A Modern Classic Based on the now legendary Pinnacle Standard, we took the tones available from that and exploded them. Those qualities are on full display within the Pinnacle Deluxe. sources.excerpt: Pinnacle Deluxe v2 Published on November 3, 2016 Wampler Pedals boost / preamp distortion pedal Information The Wampler Pinnacle Deluxe v2 is a high-gain distortion pedal engineered to deliver the celebrated EVH-inspired "Brown Sound" while offering significantly expanded tonal control and flexibility over earlier versions. Originally introduced as the Pinnacle, the circuit was praised by Zeke Clark, longtime guitar technician for Eddie Van Halen, for authentically capturing the aggressive mids, harmonic saturation, and dynamic response associated with classic hot-rodded amplifier tones. Over time, the design evolved from a straightforward high-gain distortion with interactive tone shaping into a more versatile platform capable of covering everything from mild overdrive to modern high-gain rock and metal. The original Pinnacle featured four primary controls: Gain, Volume, and two interactive tone controls that functioned similarly to a parametric-style EQ, allowing users to sweep from scooped midrange textures to thick, warm mids. A Bright switch provided additional high-frequency emphasis for darker amplifiers, while a Gain Boost toggle altered the internal gain structure to shift the pedal from overdrive into more aggressive distortion territory. The Standard and Deluxe versions shared the same core tone, with the Deluxe model replacing the Gain Boost toggle with a dedicated footswitch for on-the-fly activation and adding an internal volume trim for extended output headroom. The Deluxe enclosure was correspondingly larger to accommodate the added switching. The Pinnacle Deluxe v2 builds upon this foundation with a comprehensive redesign aimed at increased tonal sculpting and performance control. The original tone stack was replaced with an active 3-band EQ featuring dedicated Bass, Mids, and Treble controls. This expanded EQ section enables precise tone-shaping, from tight low-end punch and scooped mids to forward, cutting lead tones.
